name: The Evaluative Image of the City
description: Rebuilt from the published description of Nasar (1990). Residents and visitors mark the areas of a city they like and dislike visually on a map and describe the features behind each judgement; the results form a composite evaluative map. Differences from the original study: (1) The original used telephone and face-to-face interviews with verbal descriptions of each area; here participants draw on a map. (2) Upload one city map to the "map" folder; both mark-up pages show it.
author: Nasar
